tool.name: @BINARY@
tool.description: merges the bins of a Hi-C matrix per TAD

param.label: TAD domains
param.help: BED file of domains, for example the domains file of hicFindTADs.

tool.help:
Merge matrix bins per TAD =========================
**hicMergeTADbins** uses a BED file of domains or TAD boundaries to merge the bins of a Hi-C matrix. All bins of one domain become a single bin; the counts of the merged bins are summed.
_________________
Usage -----
The bins at the start and at the end of every domain in the BED file mark boundaries. Consecutive bins between two boundaries, and between the last boundary and the end of a chromosome, are merged into one bin. Chromosomes without a domain are merged into one bin each. Correction factors of the input matrix are removed because they no longer match the merged bins.
_________________
Output ------
A Hi-C matrix in the format of the input (cool or h5). It contains the total contacts within each TAD on the diagonal and the total contacts between each pair of TADs off the diagonal.
_________________
For more information about HiCExplorer please consider our documentation on readthedocs.io_.
.. _readthedocs.io: http://hicexplorer.readthedocs.io/en/latest/index.html
